wall.prompt: old Rajasthani haveli street wall in Jaipur: sun-baked sand-beige lime plaster (#A99474 to #BBA884) with soft mottling and hairline cracks; the band is carved sandstone jaali lattice with a thin cornice above and below; a carved stone plinth; a dusty pale sand street

window.prompt: ornate Rajasthani jharokha window: a pointed cusped Mughal arch frame of carved, hand-painted wood in warm brown and ochre covered in folk floral painting (white, teal, pink, green), a decorative crest on top, a carved sill below, both painted wooden shutters swung fully open to the sides

roof.prompt: kind elderly Rajasthani man with a white handlebar moustache, bright saffron bandhani safa turban, crisp white cotton kurta, hands joined in namaste, gentle smile

rider.prompt: traditional Indian cycle rickshaw with a young puller pedalling — red-orange Rajasthani turban, cream kurta, red dhoti — passenger hood hand-painted with colourful floral folk motifs, spoked wheels

props.name: archshop
props.prompt: deep pointed sandstone archway of a small bazaar shop, dark interior, a woman in a mustard saree at the threshold beside heaped baskets of marigolds, colourful kathputli string puppets hanging at the upper left

props.name: garlands
props.prompt: four long vertical strings of yellow-orange marigold flowers hanging side by side, each ending in white jasmine buds and a red rose tassel

props.name: frames
props.prompt: salon-style cluster of eight small antique gilded frames holding Rajasthani miniature paintings — camels, a Rajput king, a lady with a veena, elephants, a peacock, a palace

props.name: musicians
props.prompt: two Rajasthani folk musicians sitting cross-legged on a small rug — an old man in a red turban playing a ravanhatha and a younger man playing a dholak

props.name: doors
props.prompt: old weathered carved wooden double door of a haveli in a scalloped cusped arch, sun-bleached grey-brown wood with iron studs, closed

fort_day.prompt: a grand honey-sandstone Rajasthani hill fort palace with rows of jharokha balconies and chhatri domes along a ridge, seen from below; a curving stone ramp and fortified gateway in the lower third with tiny turbaned figures walking up; scrubby green hillside; soft pale lilac-and-cream sky; loose wet watercolour washes

fort_night.prompt: the same fort at night: deep navy-indigo sky with faint stars, the whole palace glowing warm golden-amber from festive lights and diyas, deep blue shadows

tower.prompt: a tall ornate red-sandstone palace tower with a domed chhatri and arched balconies draped with jasmine and marigold garlands, crenellated terracotta walls with steps to the lower right, a peacock with a long green-gold tail perched on the parapet; soft powder-blue sky with feathery white clouds
